text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y, z) ::: x flies from y to z.
Departure(x, y) ::: x's departure airport is y.
Arrival(x, y) ::: x's arrival airport is y.
Same(x, y) ::: x is the same as y.
Premises:
Flies(susan, ?, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x ∀y ∀z (Flies(x, y, z) → ¬Same(y, z)) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
Flies(john, lga, ?) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
Flies(susan, lga, ?) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
